name: Canvas device smoke
description: Drawing latency, palm rejection, sustained 60 fps scrolling, rotation and live accessibility appearance. Device observations stay manual in the run report until verified by a person. Opt-in design capture recipes for library list/folder, lasso and three document tabs are in captureRecipes; see captureGuide for extraction and required screenshot gates.

steps.manual: With Pencil draw fast loops, slow diagonals and short dots for 20 seconds at 100% and 400% zoom. Does wet ink follow the tip without a visible gap, and does every finished stroke stay visible without jumping or flickering? Record device/Pencil model and high-speed video latency as evidence.

Rest your palm and the side of your hand on the page while writing with Pencil, then lift/reposition the palm. Is there no stray ink, unintended tap, scroll or pinch? Lift Pencil and confirm intentional two-finger zoom/scroll still works.

Scroll the 32-page notebook continuously for 30 seconds with tiles filling the screen. Using an Instruments frame-rate trace or device FPS capture, is scrolling sustained at least 60 fps without blank tiles or visible stutter? Record the trace; bridge request time does not measure frame rate.

Rotate portrait to landscape and back while zoomed, then during a Pencil stroke. Does the visible page anchor stay stable, do ink and hit testing align, and are the toolbar and selection controls usable in both orientations?

Enable Reduce Transparency, then Increase Contrast in iOS Settings. Return to Nib in light and dark mode: are live glass toolbar/panels legible and opaque when requested, without hiding paper or controls? Restore settings afterward.

cleanup.name: Move disposable notebook to recoverable Trash

usage: Extract any recipe by key (libraryList, libraryFolder, lassoSelection, documentTabs):

For libraryFolder add --var folder=folder:ID; for lassoSelection add --var doc=doc:D --var page=page:D/P --var shape=item:D/P/S; for documentTabs add --var doc1=doc:A --var doc2=doc:B --var doc3=doc:C.
Recipes are opt-in so routine canvas/latency smoke checks remain unchanged. Use an isolated capture simulator/window; documentTabs closes other tabs and leaves both tab settings enabled.

For automation, execute the same steps via MCP, mapping command to nib_run, and honour every expect and CAPTURE GATE before using simctl screenshot. The stock runner does not perform visual verification or take UI screenshots.
protocol: Set device, appearance and orientation BEFORE running the recipe. Re-run all state steps after every rotation or appearance change; do not reuse an earlier context response.
Required command or context failures abort the capture. Recipes intentionally have no requires skip-list and no optional gates. A delay allows layout to settle but is never proof of visible state.

nib_context exposes document/page/selection/visibleRect/tabs, but does NOT expose library layout, search presentation, object-menu presentation or tab-strip visibility. Check library.setView responses and settings.get as well as context; use the live UI/accessibility tree for the remaining visual gates. Do not invent context fields.

For lasso, require visibleRect [x,y,w,h] to contain selection.bbox [sx,sy,sw,sh]: x <= sx, y <= sy, x+w >= sx+sw, y+h >= sy+sh. If not, reveal again or reduce zoom and reselect, then fetch fresh context. Wait up to 5 seconds for the object menu; abort if absent.
Only after all gates pass, capture the entire app window (xcrun simctl io DEVICE_UDID screenshot OUTPUT.png). nib_render and selection.screenshot omit chrome and cannot verify these states.

Each manifest entry records recipe, device, orientation, appearance, command responses, fresh nib_context, visible checks and filename. Missing/failed/manual/skipped gates are incomplete coverage, even if the runner exits 0 with --no-manual. Never save a screenshot from a manual step that was not actually verified.

Library list: No search overlay, results, keyboard, modal or sidebar covering content
Documents title and notebook list rows visible; no cover grid
Library folder: No search overlay, results, keyboard or modal
Requested folder title and its contents visible; not the library root or sidebar
Lasso selection: Requested shape fully visible above palette, with dashed selection and rigid handles
Object menu visible with Copy, Duplicate, Colour and More actions; no keyboard or covering sheet
Document tabs: Three distinct open document capsules in the Clear tab droplet
Active document and page visible; no search or covering sheet

Verify visible UI, then capture Library list
steps.manual: CAPTURE GATE: Library list. Verify the live UI against captureGuide.visibleChecks before saving a full-window screenshot.
